source: Luke's column design workbooks (UKB/UKC and hollow sections; Perega, private: the workbooks are not in this repository and only their outputs are kept). Each case recalculated in LibreOffice with the tool's class, C1 (C2 = 0) and Cm typed in ('typed'); 'sheetDefault' is the workbook's utilisation with its own defaults (Cm 0.9, C1 1.13, C2 0.45, load on the compression flange). Section properties are the workbooks' own table values. Units: kN, kNm, mm, MPa.
